title: Claude Code alternatives
summary: Claude Code alternatives: candidate paths, switching costs and reasons to keep the original.

sections.heading: Match the reason to a candidate
paragraphs: For visual iteration, trial Cursor. For provider configuration, inspect Cline. For a GitHub-oriented organization, examine the actual Copilot plan. Each path needs its own permission and data review.

sections.heading: When to keep the original
paragraphs: Keep Claude Code if the command loop is already reliable and your concern can be addressed with clearer permissions, smaller tasks or a reviewed billing configuration.

sections.heading: Migration rehearsal
paragraphs: Create a copy of the project, remove production secrets, export data using a documented method and run the tests in the candidate workflow. Compare the work needed to restore service after a failed change. Keep the original until the rehearsal succeeds.

verdict: Choose an alternative by the workflow or account boundary you need to change.
bestFor: Existing Claude Code users with a specific workflow, budget or ownership constraint
notFor: Readers expecting a replacement to move code, data and infrastructure automatically
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.
